title: Test code and implementation evidence
description: Read the test cases in src/test/java/local/foundev/zap/AlertStoreTest.java, src/test/java/local/foundev/zap/CookieAnalysisTest.java, src/test/java/local/foundev/zap/PassiveAnalyzerTest.java beside the implementation in src/main/java/local/foundev/zap/model/AlertStore.java. Explain the behavior asserted by the tests and trace each assertion to the implementation. A test file describes a check; it does not prove that check passed.
